description: This file defines a WPF UserControl for a Unit Converter in a calculator application, including UI event handling, state management, and interaction with ViewModel.

classes.name: Activatable
classes.description: A ViewModel helper class implementing IActivatable with getter and setter functions for active state.

classes.name: UnitConverter
classes.description: A sealed partial class representing the Unit Converter UI control, handling user interactions, state updates, and visual states.

methods.name: AnimateConverter
methods.description: Triggers animation if enabled.

methods.name: SetDefaultFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the first available control in a predefined order.

methods.name: OnValueKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, specifically space key to select value.

methods.name: OnContextRequested
methods.description: Handles context menu requests, shows flyout at pointer position.

methods.name: OnContextCanceled
methods.description: Hides the context menu flyout.

methods.name: OnCopyMenuItemClicked
methods.description: Copies selected calculation result to clipboard.

methods.name: OnPasteMenuItemClicked
methods.description: Pastes string from clipboard into the model asynchronously.

methods.name: OnValueSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a value, updates text state and activates it in ViewModel.

methods.name: UpdateDropDownState
methods.description: Updates ViewModel and shortcut manager about dropdown open state.

methods.name: OnLoaded
methods.description: Empty handler for control load event.

methods.name: CurrencyRefreshButton_Click
methods.description: Triggers currency ratio refresh if not already loading, handles network behavior.

methods.name: OnPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles property change notifications to update UI states.

methods.name: OnDataContextChanged
methods.description: Reattaches property changed handler when data context changes.

methods.name: OnIsDisplayVisibleChanged
methods.description: Updates visual states based on currency data visibility and loading status.

methods.name: Units1_IsEnabledChanged
methods.description: Sets default focus when Units1 becomes enabled.

methods.name: OnNetworkBehaviorChanged
methods.description: Handles UI updates based on network connectivity state.

methods.name: OnNormalNetworkAccess
methods.description: Sets UI for normal network state.

methods.name: OnOptInNetworkAccess
methods.description: Sets UI for opt-in network state.

methods.name: OnOfflineNetworkAccess
methods.description: Sets UI for offline network state.

methods.name: InitializeOfflineStatusTextBlock
methods.description: Parses resource string to set offline status hyperlink text pieces.

methods.name: SetNormalCurrencyStatus
methods.description: Clears secondary status text.

methods.name: SetChargesMayApplyStatus
methods.description: Sets UI state indicating charges may apply.

methods.name: SetFailedToRefreshStatus
methods.description: Sets UI state indicating currency refresh failed.

methods.name: SetCurrencyTimestampFontWeight
methods.description: Updates timestamp font weight based on data freshness.

methods.name: StartProgressRingWithDelay
methods.description: Starts a delayed progress ring activation.

methods.name: OnDelayTimerTick
methods.description: Activates progress ring after delay.

methods.name: HideProgressRing
methods.description: Stops delay timer and deactivates progress ring.

methods.name: SupplementaryResultsPanelInGrid_SizeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts row height based on size change.

methods.name: OnVisualStateChanged
methods.description: Logs visual state changes.
